business_objective: Collect guardian decisions for an educational visit and produce a final roster containing only eligible students.

stakeholder_statements.text: The teacher creates a visit record with the visit title and date, then lists the invited students.
A guardian may accept or decline participation for the named student.
The attendance clerk records the guardian response and marks the student eligible only when participation is accepted.
The trip coordinator records the final roster using the students marked eligible.
The trip lead closes the visit roster only after the final roster is recorded. Transport booking and fee collection are outside this project.

business_objective: Review and apply extension requests for active workspace guest access after resource-owner acceptance and guest acknowledgement.

stakeholder_statements.text: A workspace sponsor submits a guest-access extension request and identifies the guest and proposed new end date.
The access coordinator confirms that the guest access is active and records the resources covered by the request. The resource categories are not settled.
The resource owner accepts or declines the extension for the resources they control and may add a decision comment. The decision criteria have not been agreed.
The guest records acknowledgement of the current guest-use terms before an extension takes effect.

The workspace access clerk updates the guest-access end date only after resource-owner acceptance and guest acknowledgement, then sends the outcome to the workspace sponsor. The delivery channel is undecided, and converting a guest to a member and changing subscription billing are outside this project.

business_objective: Review requests to change a consignment's unloading priority and communicate the final unloading sequence before departure.

stakeholder_statements.text: A destination contact requests priority unloading for a consignment and states the operational reason.
The route planner records the current stop sequence and the requested new position. The allowable position changes are not agreed.
The dispatch coordinator checks the effect on other stops and records the request as approved or rejected. The evaluation criteria are undecided.
For an approved request, the loading coordinator records the revised load position before departure.
The driver receives the final unloading sequence and records acknowledgement before departure. The delivery channel is undecided, and vehicle navigation and freight pricing are outside this project.

business_objective: Review voluntary permit-surrender requests and mark accepted permits as surrendered after evidence and compliance checks.

stakeholder_statements.text: A permit holder submits a surrender request and identifies the permit and intended cessation date.
The service clerk checks whether supporting evidence is present and returns an incomplete request. The required evidence list has not been agreed.
The compliance officer records whether outstanding obligations exist and adds details when they do. The obligation categories are not finalized.
After the evidence and compliance checks are present, the permit reviewer records the request as accepted or returned and adds a reason when it is returned.

The registry officer marks the permit surrendered only after acceptance and sends the outcome to the permit holder. The delivery channel is undecided, and permit renewal and fee refunds are outside this project.

business_objective: Record proposed manuscript authorship, contributor responses, readiness, integrity concerns, and authorized external submission while preserving an unresolved approval rule.

stakeholder_statements.text: The corresponding author creates a manuscript submission record, lists the proposed authors, and links the current draft.
Each listed contributor records their contribution statement and either approves the author list or raises an authorship concern.

The research lead records whether the manuscript is ready for submission. The lead says submission may proceed when every responding contributor approves, even if an unavailable contributor has not responded.
The research integrity reviewer records any authorship concern and says the manuscript must not be submitted until every listed contributor approves the author list.

The publication coordinator records the external submission only after a submission authorization is present. Nobody has decided who may classify a contributor as unavailable or who grants the submission authorization when a concern exists. The meeting also drifted into a discussion about the conference-room plants.
